## Personality

Lilly is characterized by her tendency to recount her various physical afflictions in explicit detail. She appears to derive a gruesome sense of pleasure from sharing these descriptions of her aches, pains, and illnesses with others.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003)_

## Traits

- takes a gruesome pleasure in detailing her aches and sicknesses  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003)</sub>

## History

Lilly is a quirky guest staying at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) during the summer. She resides there alongside other eccentric visitors while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits the location.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_
